What do other customers say in their reviews, does it actually hold up?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Good question. Reviews are a strong signal when you are choosing a tool.
92% of consumers read online reviews before buying, and 88% trust them as much as personal recommendations. Positive testimonials also make people trust a business more. 
That is why many creators add testimonials to their pages. They help build trust with potential customers.
There is also a technical side to reliability. Kajabi has achieved SOC 2 and PCI DSS Level 1 compliance, which means an independent audit reviewed its security and privacy controls. 
Payments inside Kajabi run on the same processing engine as Stripe, which is widely used for secure payment processing. 
So the feedback loop is simple: creators build products, customers leave testimonials, and the platform is designed to support that trust and security.
